module: local sample presets and ordinary combinations
intentional_differences: Committed local presets now survive reopening in sample_local_* tables; original presets were held in rackList/CusSampleHole memory. In-progress edits remain in the GUI until committed. Local IDs never represent instrument task/report IDs.

Shared catalog uses stable project IDs and FK RESTRICT for preset and combination references. Ordered combination member IDs preserve repetitions; project_contain retains the original semicolon representation on save.

Guest is read-only; explicit authenticated offline roles 1-5 may edit local presets. The inspected original sample entry has no explicit role gate; this is a local offline editing policy, not production authentication.

Original UI geometry, grouping, material controls, rack/hole images and task capsules are preserved. Only the promoted embedded setting widget is hosted by the thin SamplePage adapter. Resource paths use module qrc paths.
Linux uses available Noto Sans CJK SC instead of unavailable PingFang; active original Windows theme/pixel comparison is still pending.

Original custom container popup depended on mainWinPtr and mismatched global coordinates. It now owns a Qt::Popup with screen-bounded coordinates; its source icon/text styling is retained. A temporary QFontMetrics heap leak was removed.

Original batch boundary checked i against rowCount instead of currentRow+i; copying clamps to the actual remaining holes. Automatic numeric IDs require <=4 digits rather than producing an invalid sample ID.
Both sample ID inputs now validate the original detail-dialog 0-4 letters/digits rule. The original table editor only called toInt and could display text not reflected in its value object.

Configured rate labels come exclusively from ProjectRecord.sampleRates and are rechecked against the current worker catalog. Missing/invalid/multiple defaults never create a production 1:1 assumption. Anonymous OFFLINE_RATE_A/B only exercise selection semantics.

Repetition 0-99 follows the original detail editor; quick-selector displays an existing non-listed count such as 0/99 accurately. Worker rejects larger counts; one combination is bounded to 512 entries.

Original Emergency update could call slotSendRackTasks during Testing/Prepared/Pause. This module only commits a local preset; it does not create transport/LIS, allocate device/report IDs, consume reagent or generate reports.

Actual instrument execution, pause/recovery, calibration/QC, MDA, multi-bottle control and consumption-based sufficiency remain explicitly unavailable; local reagent quantities are not measured liquid levels.
Dialogs use asynchronous open with a unified Esc/title-close/mask guard; failed writes retain inputs, dirty dependency refreshes never overwrite edits, all SQL belongs to its worker.

Post-render QA corrected delayed QListWidget item-widget lookup: synchronization now searches only current itemWidget trees, so checked project and 0/99 counts agree with saved tasks. Dialog captures wait until the original mask animation has exposed live widgets.
Source table 60px header styling is applied after constructing its custom header; horizontal scrolling remains disabled as in the reference constructor.
